_comment: Local/tailnet inference endpoints probed by scripts/discover_endpoints.py. 'url' is the OpenAI-compatible base — the scripts append /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions. Add or remove entries freely; unreachable ones are reported as down, never fatal.

endpoints.name: llama-swap-studio
endpoints.notes: Primary fleet. launchd ai.llama-swap. Config ~/.hermes/llama-swap/config.yaml (hot-reloads). Loads models on demand -> first call per model can take a minute.

endpoints.name: llama-swap-studio-tailnet
endpoints.notes: Same server as llama-swap-studio, reached over Tailscale. Use from the MBP or Mini. Self-signed cert -> probes pass --insecure.

endpoints.name: llama-swap-mbp
endpoints.notes: MacBook llama-swap. run.sh binds the TAILNET IP 100.68.81.83:8999, not loopback, so it IS reachable from the Studio -- the old 127.0.0.1:8999 entry could never work off-box. Id prefix is 'mb-' (config keys), not 'macbook-'. Daemonized by ai.llama-swap.daemon.plist, so it is absent from `launchctl list` while still serving. GGUF lib /Users/prasta/Models, so GGUF paths only resolve on the MBP itself.

endpoints.name: llama-swap-mbp-loopback
endpoints.notes: Same server as llama-swap-mbp, seen from ON the MBP. Only answers when the probe runs on that machine; expected down from the Studio. GGUF size resolution works there because the paths are local.

endpoints.name: lm-studio
endpoints.notes: Local inference only, not part of the served fleet. Its /v1/models lists every downloaded model incl. embeddings, VAEs and text encoders — filter before benchmarking.

endpoints.name: lm-studio-mbp
endpoints.notes: Retired 2026-08-08 (LM Studio + com.lmstudio.watchdog removed from the MBP). Kept so the probe confirms it stays gone.

endpoints.name: omlx
endpoints.notes: oMLX app server (settings.json server.port=8010). Requires API key (auth.skip_api_key_verification=false) — api_key field reads it from settings.json. MLX 4-bit ids look like Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MLX-4bit. Loads models on demand; /v1/models empty until a model loads.

endpoints.name: mlx-lm
endpoints.notes: Default port for `mlx_lm.server`. Serves one model per process — /v1/models often reports a single id or the local path.

endpoints.name: ollama
endpoints.notes: OpenAI-compatible under /v1. Native list is /api/tags. Not installed on the Studio as of 2026-09-13 — single-engine policy is llama.cpp/GGUF via llama-swap.

endpoints.name: vllm
endpoints.notes: CUDA-only in practice — will not run on Apple Silicon. Port 8000 is commonly squatted by dev servers, so the probe requires a well-formed /v1/models payload before calling it UP.
